governance_and_audit.role_enforcement: Staff/Admin (STAFF_ROLES) strictly required to verify partners or moderate experience listings; non-staff receive HTTP 403 FORBIDDEN_SCOPE
governance_and_audit.audit_trail: Append-only cryptographic hash chain logging into rbpc_content_audit for onboarding, profile edits, verifications, and moderations
governance_and_audit.reverification_trigger: Editing artisan portrait URL automatically marks is_verified=False and consent_status='pending_review' requiring staff re-review

negative_abuse_invariant.rule: Unverified partner cannot publish portrait or experience listing without staff verification.
enforcement: Public endpoint GET /api/v1/rbpc/creators/{slug} redacts approved_portrait_url to None whenever creator.is_verified is False.
Staff moderation endpoint /api/v1/rbpc/admin/experiences/{id}/moderate rejects publication_state='published' with HTTP 400 RBPC_UNVERIFIED_ARTISAN if creator.is_verified is False.
Staff moderation endpoint rejects publication_state='published' with HTTP 400 RBPC_RIGHTS_NOT_CHECKED if rights_checked is False.
Public endpoint GET /api/v1/rbpc/experiences/{slug} and story experiences return HTTP 404 if linked creator is unverified.

endpoints.description: Authenticated partner self-onboarding registering creator profile in pending_review state
Update artisan profile details with auto re-verification upon portrait modification
Staff verification of partner identity, consent documents, and rights clearance
Partner creation of cultural experience offering in draft state
Staff moderation and rights check for experience listing

features: Interactive navigation tabs: Inquiries Inbox, Artisan Profile & Verification, and Register Experience
Self-onboarding and profile editing form with consent and identity reference fields
Real-time verification badge indicators (Verified vs Pending Staff Verification)
Experience listing submission form in Draft mode awaiting moderation
